payload.title: Preserve living-report attachments when storing terminal output
payload.description:
As an operator, I want terminal procedure output persistence to preserve every previously attached living-report artifact, so that completing a procedure cannot erase the Task's durable evidence index.

Feature: Merge terminal output attachments
Scenario: Final output is added to an existing living-report task
  Given a running Task already references immutable report evidence and workbook attachments
  When the procedure stores its terminal output artifact
  Then the output artifact is appended exactly once
  And every existing attachment remains present
  And concurrent or stale Task objects cannot replace the authoritative attachment list

Out of scope: new storage resources, inline artifact fallbacks, retention policy, and client-specific evidence.
